cevisa-std.name: CHP 7 · CHP 12 · CHP 12 INV standard shearing bevellers, bevel to 11/16″
cevisa-std.summary: The portable bevellers that do most of a fabrication shop's weld preparation: the machine sits on the plate edge, a shear cutter takes the bevel off cold in one or several runs, and the machine feeds itself along the edge — on the CHP 12 a 20 ft plate is bevelled in under three minutes. The 99 lb CHP 7 bevels plate, tube and aluminum from 1/8″ to 5/8″ thick to a 3/8″ bevel; the CHP 12, Cevisa's best-known machine since 1972, takes 1/4″ to 1-9/16″ plate to an 11/16″ bevel at 8.5 ft/min; the CHP 12 INV is the same machine working upside down on the lower edge, so an X bevel needs no plate turning. V, X, K and Y bevels at 22.5° to 45°; tube from Ø3-15/16″ inside, bevelled inside or out.
cevisa-std.headline: Plate & tube 1/8″ – 1-9/16″ · bevel to 11/16″ · 22.5° – 45° · self-feeding
features: Self-feeding along the plate edge — no pushing and no supervision while it bevels

cevisa-adj.name: CHP 12G · CHP 21G · CHP 21G INV adjustable-angle bevellers, bevel to 1-1/8″
cevisa-adj.summary: Adjustable-angle bevellers for production weld preparation: the bevel angle is set anywhere from 20° to 45° on the machine itself, and the trolley holds machine and plate in the best working position, which steadies the cut and lengthens cutter life. The CHP 12G is the adjustable CHP 12 — 1/4″ to 1-3/16″ plate, an 11/16″ bevel at 8.5 ft/min. The CHP 21G is built for round-the-clock work: 3/8″ to 1-15/16″ plate and a 1-1/8″ bevel in several runs (13/16″ in one) on a built-in trolley. The CHP 21G INV bevels the lower edge of heavy plate without turning it over, and side by side with a CHP 21G one operator bevels both edges.

cevisa-rev.name: CHP 12G REV · CHP 21G REV reversible bevellers, bevel to 1-1/8″
cevisa-rev.summary: Two bevellers in one: the head turns over on its frame in under a minute, so the same machine cuts the upper bevel and then the lower one without anyone turning the plate — X, K, V and Y bevels on large and heavy plate with one machine and one operator, and no crane work to flip the plate. The CHP 12G REV bevels 1/4″ to 1-3/16″ plate to an 11/16″ bevel at 8.5 ft/min; the CHP 21G REV combines a CHP 21G and a CHP 21G INV for 3/8″ to 1-15/16″ plate and a 1-1/8″ bevel. Bevel angle adjustable from 20° to 45° on both.

cevisa-mill.name: CHP 30G · CHP 60G · CHP 60G INV · CHP 100G milling bevellers, bevel to 3-15/16″
cevisa-mill.models_label: CHP 30G · CHP 60G · CHP 60G INV · CHP 100G · 4 models
cevisa-mill.summary: Portable milling machines that bevel: an insert milling head machines the bevel while feed rollers carry the machine along the plate and pneumatic clamps hold it down — a machined face with no heat and no grinding, in any material from mild steel to Hardox and duplex at the same capacity, at 15° to 70°, with transition and J bevels. CHP 30G: plate 1/8″ – 1-15/16″, bevel to 1-3/8″. CHP 60G: plate 3/8″ – 2-3/4″ (3-15/16″ in special configuration), bevel to 2-3/8″, and the CHP 60G INV for lower bevels. CHP 100G: plate to 4-3/4″, bevel to 3-15/16″.
